name: hud_ui_check_toggle_widget_set_checked
description: HudUiCheckToggleWidget::SetChecked stores the new checked state, swaps to the checked or unchecked image when present, toggles the checked label panel visibility, invalidates itself, and returns the previous checked state.

functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b72c0 stores the incoming checked value at offset 0x14c, conditionally applies checkedImage or uncheckedImage through HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, dispatches checkedLabelPanel SetVisible through ftable slot 0x60 when present, dispatches Invalidate through self ftable slot 0x20, and returns the previous checked value.
